ctxflow_graph.method: direct CtxFlow graph query; no agent pipeline

configuration.token_estimate: SimpleTokenizer simple-v1: regex word and punctuation tokens; deterministic estimate, not a provider tokenizer.
configuration.supersession_ground_truth: Explicitly injected from the synthetic dataset; does not evaluate automatic contradiction detection.

question_rationales.rationale: Tests whether the correction supersedes a widely reported but leakage-affected score.
Tests selection of the strongest result whose validation is explicitly leakage-isolated.
Covers an efficiency claim unrelated to the superseded accuracy result.
Checks that an explanation of the evaluation flaw retrieves the correction rather than the invalid score.
Checks exact performance and validation context for the leakage-resistant method.
Adds a second independent supersession case to avoid relying on one correction scenario.
Tests retrieval of the concrete cause behind the independent Algorithm W correction.
Checks provenance attribution for a correction, not just retrieval of its numeric value.
Requires both independent corrections while suppressing both superseded scores.
Checks source attribution for a non-accuracy claim to broaden coverage beyond supersession.

limitations: Synthetic benchmark with five papers and ten questions; results are not statistically significant.
Answer and provenance metrics use normalized substring matching.
Flat baselines use a deterministic hashed lexical embedder, not semantic embeddings.
CtxFlow graph evaluation queries the graph directly and does not run agents.
Supersession links are manually injected from benchmark annotations; automatic detection is not evaluated.
Context tokens use the deterministic simple-v1 word/punctuation tokenizer, not a provider tokenizer.
The benchmark does not invoke the ResearchOS synthesis prompt; its fingerprint is reported as a reference only.
The multi-agent-shaped flat baseline over-fetches 2k candidates while retaining at most k context items.
